catalog.agent_visibility: Complete raw materials, answers and references may be selected for an Environment; the developer controls their use.
catalog.archive_scope: Selected upstream archive; external build dependencies and separately distributed datasets are excluded.
catalog.container_strategy: Stage as controller-owned source material and admit individual cases after per-file license and timing review.

corpus_contract.oracle: Per-case checks must be audited; a successful exit alone can be insufficient.
corpus_contract.split_unit: Original program provenance, not individual files.

catalog.purpose: Supplement correctness, integer/control-flow and embedded-style compiler coverage.
qualification_gaps: The collection has heterogeneous provenance and is oriented to WCET work; not every case is a useful host runtime benchmark.
Per-benchmark redistribution and input/oracle contracts must be checked before publishing derived corpus bundles.
catalog.redistribution_status: Not approved for redistribution before per-component provenance and license review; public availability alone is insufficient.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
catalog.title: TACLeBench embedded C collection

locations.label: Complete original source and data tree
locations.purpose: Independent full upstream materials, notices, references, tests, inputs and answers.

notes: This material artifact preserves every file of the exact original archive. Installation copies materials independently and performs a full content check.
Availability checks do not compile corpus programs, validate numerical output, run an official benchmark protocol or grant an OCI/physical-target qualification.
Dataset load/prepare and sample operations are separately recorded under resource-integrations/v0210/r02/static-data/evidence. The original upstream lock and metadata.catalog remain unchanged.
usage.summary: Supplement correctness, integer/control-flow and embedded-style compiler coverage.
